name: Ollama
formats_schema: Model store is content-addressed: blobs sha256-<digest> (GGUF + template/params/license layers), manifests are JSON (OCI-like) per model:tag. REPL history is plaintext. API /api/chat is stateless: prompts appear only in server.log (verbose levels) and client apps. arXiv 2603.23996 reports Ollama plaintext prompt histories in JSON and file signatures.
ports_processes: TCP 127.0.0.1:11434 (OLLAMA_HOST); processes ollama.exe, 'ollama app.exe', runner subprocess (ollama_llama_server / 'ollama runner')
env_vars: OLLAMA_MODELS, OLLAMA_HOST, OLLAMA_ORIGINS, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE, OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL, OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS, OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION, OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE, OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD, OLLAMA_DEBUG (unverified), HTTPS_PROXY
memory_artifacts: Loaded model resident in runner process (KV cache, prompts/responses in RAM); model unloaded after OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE (5m default). Dump runner process for prompt strings.
install_artifacts: Windows installer OllamaSetup.exe, per-user; startup shortcut; registry uninstall key (unverified)
retention: No auto-expiry documented; server-#.log rotated by app (rotation policy unverified); history grows unbounded
